redirects to

  • CURIE: gmeow:exemplarRedirect
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplarRedirect
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

For cautionary exemplars: the criterion this passage ACTUALLY evidences — 'clinical trust frameworks belong to polymath competence, not the covenant'. NOT functional: a boundary case may touch several axes.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Exemplar -> gmeow:Criterion

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:exemplarRedirect from gmeow:Exemplar to gmeow:Criterion when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Exemplar, gmeow:Criterion

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use on a cautionary exemplar to name the criterion the passage ACTUALLY evidences — the redirect from the axis it superficially resembles.

Avoid when

  • Avoid it on positive or negative exemplars (it is the cautionary redirect) and avoid forcing a single target — a boundary case may touch several axes, so keep it non-functional.

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:exemplarRedirect from a cautionary gmeow:Exemplar to the gmeow:Criterion it really evidences; pair it with gmeow:exemplarPolarity gmeow:polarityCautionary.

Examples

  • ex:ex1 gmeow:exemplarRedirect ex:polymathCompetence.
